title: criptotianguis.mx
tagline: Cripto tianguis MX is a 100% web3 evm phone refills and payments market
description: This is a 100% Web3 EVM natively multichain web shop for the Mexican market allowing to top-up phone credit with Web3 tokens. It will also have payments for services  like electricity and water, internet etc and some government services. It is meant to help people in Mexico make it easy to live in crypto without the need to cash out. Future plans are to assign a % of the profit for donations to fx. organizations that do social work or environmental work. I am also considering to use a % of the profit for a staking pool.
how_its_made: It is made with NextJS, Tailwind for styling and web3-react to connect to wallets. Officially you can use Metamask and WalletConnect, but others like trustwallet should also work via WalletConnect. The app connects to  an api from a Mexican provider company that sells the payments and top-ups, which are then presented to the user in a simple and easy to use interface designed to be fast to use and also good to use for touch devices.
